svg.title: Azores: two dated width sections at 24.5 W
svg.desc: Independent section locator, with north up and latitude to scale. The westward Azores Countercurrent is bounded by stations 42 and 46, 36.25 to 35.25 N. The eastward Azores Current is bounded by stations 49 and 53, 34.5 to 33.5 N. Each reported span is approximately 110 km. Arrows indicate direction only, not along-current length or speed. One survey, not a seasonal cycle. Methods occupation dates are 26 October to 1 November 2009; Figure 1 caption says 2010 and the conflict is unresolved.

g.text: 24.5 W / 26 Oct-1 Nov 2009, as reported in the methods
North up; latitude to scale. Horizontal arrows show flow direction only.

g.title: Azores Countercurrent: about 110 km source-reported meridional section span
Azores Current: about 110 km source-reported meridional section span

g.text: These are two source-delimited section spans, not whole-current lengths or footprints.
No fixed width layer, numerical width error or annual width range is established.
Date conflict retained: Figure 1 says fall 2010; methods specify the 2009 occupation.
Source: Comas-Rodriguez et al. (2011), Figures 1,5,6,8 and Results / DOI:10.1029/2011JC007129.
OSW independent section locator. Original date conflict retained; one survey, not a seasonal cycle.
